analysis.title: AI implodes, bonds explode and Bessent gets the last laugh
key_insights: The US 10-year yield fell about 15bps in one day, the largest one-day decline since August 2025 per GS. The AI unwind is pushing investors to reassess longer-term growth expectations, which raises demand for duration.
AI stocks are falling, growth expectations are being repriced lower, and Treasury yields are dropping. Lower yields reduce Treasury borrowing costs, which aligns with Bessent's stated goal.

The October 8 note 'Everybody is betting on higher rates, that is the problem' argued for a yield reversal, citing crowded positioning, stretched technicals and The Economist cover as a contrarian signal. Two weeks later the 10-year moved from channel highs to its 50-day moving average, just above channel lows.
The report says the tactical call has played out and that 'from here, things get trickier'.
The move in yields was large enough that bond volatility rose. Bond vol remains elevated and the report expects more big swings.
The Nasdaq and US 10-year yield correlation remains strong. GS's Privorotsky: 'the very thing creating the equity problem is helping solve the rates problem.'
The US 10-year has closed below the short-term CTA threshold, which could trigger more systematic bond buying. Flight-to-quality demand could add to trend-following flows.
JPM flagged CTA risk in early October: trend followers had been riding the bond selloff and positioning was increasingly vulnerable to mean reversion.
The AI selloff is pricing in lower capex and weaker growth, which takes pressure off yields. GS's Privorotsky highlights a divergence between rates and oil.
If AI stabilizes and growth expectations recover, yields could come under renewed upward pressure.

tension_points.bull_case: The AI selloff lowers capex and growth expectations, which pulls yields lower. Systematic CTA buying below the threshold and flight-to-quality demand could extend the bond rally.
tension_points.bear_case: If AI stabilizes and growth expectations recover, yields could come under renewed upward pressure. Elevated bond vol means large swings, and the easy part of the move is done.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A stabilization in AI stocks and a recovery in growth expectations, which would push yields back up.
